name: CDJ Player View
author: MiuxH
summary: Experimental 1/2/4 player view using native AZ waveform and cue renderers.
description: First community test port of the existing V22 player presentation. Firmware-specific native paint hook reuses AZ detail waveform, grid and preview component trees, including available native cue markers. SDK text uses installed AZ fonts. Blue/RGB/3 Band follow the native SHORTCUT setting. Preserves native Beat FX and physical controls. Touch audio sheets, preview seek/counter and sync-master identity are not yet ported; moved audio areas consume touches. No network, direct file writes or audio processing. Runtime verification pending.
